text:
Alex M: quick q — should our region handshake include a weighted-latency component or keep it simple (prefer-local then fallback)? trying to avoid flip-flopping when probes jitter.
Priya S: i'd vote weighted-latency. translate SLO gap into a soft score so small spikes don't move routes. maybe hysteresis + cooldown window. :thinking:
Jonas K: agree with priya. also need header compatibility for tenants that pin regions via `X-Region-Pref`. that should bypass weighting but still respect capacity limits.
Nina L: +1 on header bypass but warn: bypass must still check failover policy for degraded regions, otherwise customers get errors.
Alex M: proposal sketch:
```
- compute region_score = latency_weight * normalized_latency + cost_weight * normalized_cost
- prefer region with lowest region_score if score gap > threshold
- cooldown: once switched, keep for min_stick_seconds unless severe SLO breach
- header pin: if X-Region-Pref present -> try pinned region first, else apply scoring
```
Priya S: we should also treat warm-standby differently: if standby warm then treat latency as penalized until preflight probe passes. prevents immediate routing to cold capacity.
Jonas K: re: probes — make them lightweight pings that include a short warmup token to ensure kv-cache primed. Example probe config:
```
probe:
  path: /_probe/handshake
  timeout_ms: 120
  success_threshold: 2/3
  warmup_token: true
```
Nina L: ops concern: how do we surface this in console? need a per-route table: current_region, candidate_regions, score_breakdown, last_switch_ts. otherwise oncall can't triage.
Alex M: yes console fields: score_breakdown (latency, cost, capacity, manual_pin), last_probe, cooldown_remaining. also expose a debug header `X-RW-Route-Score` with JSON blob for traces (redact in prod logs).
Priya S: one more: allow per-tenant override of threshold via route config + entitlements. some customers (regulated) will want stronger affinity.
Jonas K: will draft PR to runtime: add scoring function + header bypass flag. small integration test: simulate jitter and assert no flip for 60s if gap < threshold.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch alex/region-score landed on staging — running integration tests
Nina L: thanks. can we also add a metric `region_switch_rate` per tenant in telemetry? want alert if >1 switch/min for any tenant.
Alex M: good call. that'll catch thrashers. ok i'll open a console ticket for UI table and a runtime issue for scoring + probes. assigning to @Jonas K and @Priya S.
